label: soco54 marginal gas basis
definition: SOCO-54: gas_plant_monthly_fuel_pricing turned OFF against the SOCO-53f keeper — the field's own shipped default — so every SOCO gas unit prices on the realized Henry Hub level plus SOCO's own measured EIA-923 delivered-gas basis (GAS_BASIS_DIFFERENTIAL['SOCO'] = 0.64, registered by SOCO-20 from those same receipts) instead of each plant's own monthly delivered-CONTRACT print. A dispatch offer is a MARGINAL cost and the print is an AVERAGE DELIVERED CONTRACT cost, so this is rule 14 [R-ACCURATE]'s misalignment clause and the swap is measured-to-measured. The basis is measured, not argued: eight SOCO plants file one common monthly shape x a plant-constant multiplier in all three years at ratio CV <= 0.00081, and the multipliers REPRICE with no physical cause — Yates goes 1.8279 -> 1.1669 -> 0.7959 against Hartwell, whose own 2023 print sits below Henry Hub in 11 of 12 months, which no DELIVERED gas can do. ZERO ScenarioConfig fields and ZERO free parameters added (DOF 3 entries / 1 residual, unchanged). Rule 19 [R-ONE-MECH] holds at two grains: only the six GAS classes move on fuel_prices and mc_base, with coal, oil, nuclear, hydro, wind, solar and biomass at max |delta| exactly 0.000000000000 in all three years — a marginal-COST statement; coal DISPATCH does move as a second-order effect (2023 COAL_PRB +1.481 TWh, toward its actual). RESULT, AND IT IS BENCH-DEPENDENT: on the COMMITTED bench this clears the keeper's failing C1 row (2023 CT_PEAKER +9.73 TWh / +4.0pp -> +6.13 TWh / +2.55pp against a +/-3.00pp cap) to a full C1 PASS, 14/14, moving the determination NOT-YET -> PHYSICALLY-CALIBRATED (PRICE UNSCORED); on the FRESHLY REBUILT bench the run reads NOT-YET, because 2024 CC_REGULAR lands at +7.505 TWh against a +/-7.47 band (+7.417 on the committed bench — a 0.05 TWh pass) — the row PRECOMMIT-soco-54 P4 pre-registered as this arm's stated risk. 2023 CT_PEAKER closes on BOTH benches. SOCO has no price benchmark and never will, so C3a/C3b/C3c are UNSCORABLE and this is never a CALIBRATED reading. PROMOTION IS OPEN AND UNRULED (rule 31 [R-RETAIN]); the keeper is unchanged and nothing was pruned.
